model: torchvision Mask R-CNN ResNet50 FPN v2, COCO initialization, two output classes
training_data: recorded simulation RGB-D; capture-time truth used for OFFLINE automatic capped-cylinder masks only

interruption.first_segment: external SIGTERM at step 240; source not established; checkpoint saved

limitations: Same simulated cylinder, appearance, background family and 0.60 m table height
No cross-object, unseen-height, real-camera or grasp-success validation
Auto-label cylinder/depth agreement is not human-reviewed ground truth for every frame
Sparse recorded frames are correlated; frame counts are not independent task trials
Single offline GPU inference timing is not end-to-end or realtime validation
No changes to GMPC, online vision estimator or existing safety guards
